place.summary: Citygate Outlets functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is PH. It receives notable inbound connections from Hong Kong International Airport. Visitors often continue to Ngong Ping 360. Its observed experience trails the category average, despite existing visitor demand.

opportunity_cards.title: Strong onward link to Ngong Ping 360
opportunity_cards.detail: Visitors often continue from Citygate Outlets to Ngong Ping 360, with relatively strong journey experience.

opportunity_cards.title: High visibility, weaker experience
opportunity_cards.detail: Citygate Outlets draws meaningful traffic but performs below its category average on experience.
